title: GitMachine
description: A computer published to OpenVibe.Git through Link, read-only. Link connects out to Git, sends its name and the repositories under the root the person chose in Link, and keeps watching: the page lists the machine and browses its tree, files and log through Link while it is online. The request never reaches the machine; Git only asks on a poll the machine opened. Nothing here is a write path.

id.description: The machine's own id (mch_<ULID>), minted by Git when the person connects it.

name.description: The computer's name, as Link knows it.

os.description: linux, darwin or windows, for the page's small label.

online.description: True when Link has checked in within the last thirty seconds.

offline_since.description: When the machine was last seen before going offline; null while it is online.

name.description: The folder's name, lower-case, the same rule as a Git repository name.

branch.description: The branch checked out in that folder.

head.description: The commit's full SHA (SHA-1, or SHA-256 when the repository uses it).
